Anatomy rules: exactly one person, one head on their own shoulders, the same person in both shots. A face never appears on clothes, hands or legs. Natural walk, stable ground contact. No second person, no extra limbs, no logos, no watermark and no other text.

### 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 11 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt

```text
Four plush costume characters hop one by one over a muddy farm trench toward the camera, and the green one falls in. Vertical 9:16, photorealistic: ONE continuous take, the camera fixed low at ground level on the near side of a muddy trench, looking across it. Warm golden-hour light.

RED: red, with a small round loop antenna. YELLOW: yellow, with a thin curly antenna. GREEN: lime-green, with a straight upright stick antenna. PURPLE: purple and the tallest, with an upside-down triangle antenna. Each wears a chubby, velvety full-body plush costume with a round hood that frames the face in a round opening, the antenna on top, short mitten arms and a grey square belly panel; they waddle and bounce.

WHO IS WHO: GREEN is the person in [Image 1], in every frame. Red, yellow and purple each have a plain, smooth, pale doll-like face, never the face from [Image 1]. Each person's own real face fills the round opening of their hood, large and sharp: the exact face from their own image (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), never a doll face. Never blend or swap faces. Each face stays the same in every frame, also mid-jump and splashed with mud, so friends recognize them at once. The costumes cover the bodies: never the clothes from the photos.

A farm field at sunset: a trench of brown mud and muddy water, about one metre wide, runs across the bottom of the frame; behind it grass, rows of tall corn, a pale wooden barn far back on the left, a pink evening sky. No vehicles, no other people, no sun with a face, no letters anywhere.

0-2.5 s: the four queue on the far side of the trench, staggered so every face shows: red at the front near the camera, then yellow, green, purple. Red looks down, says "uh oh!", hops over toward the camera with a big two-footed jump and out of frame on the right.
2.5-5 s: yellow steps to the edge, flaps its arms, says "uh oh!", hops over and bounces out on the right.
5-6.2 s: green steps to the edge in the middle of the frame, the face large and sharp: exactly the face from [Image 1], looks down nervously, says a small "uh oh..." and jumps too short.
6.2-8 s: SPLAT: green belly-flops into the muddy water with a big brown splash. Behind, purple stops at the edge, looks down at green, turns around and waddles away into the field.
8-11 s: green pushes up out of the mud, dripping brown, the face muddy but clear: exactly the face from [Image 1], stares into the camera in shock, then climbs out on the far side and waddles off after purple.

Audio: birds and a light breeze. Before its jump each one says only "uh oh!" in a high, squeaky, cheerful voice. On the fall a loud wet splash, squelching mud, a shocked gasp, then a small whimpering "uh oh...". No other words, no swearing. No background music. Exactly four characters, one head each: never a fifth, never a real child. No captions, no text, no watermark, no logo.
```

```text

The ONLY change: the woman who kicks the pumpkin is now the person in [Image 1]. [Image 1] is the sole reference for the kicker's face and hair; [Video 1] is for the moves, the effects and the camera only.

The kicker = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY frame, also in the spin, in the kick and in the black-and-white ending: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles). The same real person in every frame, so their friends instantly recognize them. Never morph, never drift back to the original woman's face: not her face shape, her eyes, her nose or her full lips. For a man: the same red hooded cape over a white shirt, a black laced vest and dark trousers.

The moves, second by second:
0-1 s: the empty table in front of the fairground lights.
1-2 s: the kicker steps in from the right and sets a glowing carved jack-o'-lantern with two small black horns on the table.
2-5.3 s: stands behind the table, holds the pumpkin by its stem, looks down at it, then pulls a cheeky, sassy face at the camera.
5.3-6 s: turns away in a fast spin, the cape flaring wide.
6-6.4 s: the spinning high kick hits the pumpkin: it bursts into big orange pieces that fly off the table.
6.4-10 s: the picture freezes into black-and-white slow motion: the kicker hangs in the air at the end of the kick, pumpkin pieces and snowflakes float, and a white handwritten cursive title "Halloween" writes itself across the middle of the frame, letter by letter, exactly as in the video.

Only replace the kicker; the fairground, the table, the pumpkin, the kick, the freeze, the black-and-white look, the snow and the title stay completely unchanged. Keep everything else the same.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the kicker's shoulders. Two arms, two legs, five fingers on each hand. Exactly one person. The only text is the single word "Halloween" in the same white cursive script: no other text, no captions, no logos, no watermark. No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.
```

### 3. Press the film button on the still to open AI Video with the still as the first frame. Settings: Kling 3.0, 10 s, 1080p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt

```text
A real, funny pet video filmed on a phone held still: one continuous tight close-up at the pet's eye level, the head filling most of the frame the whole time, the camera locked off. 1.5-3.5 s: both eyes pop wide open, big and round, and stare straight into the lens; the mouth opens wide into a big open-mouthed grin, like a laugh, the pink tongue showing, while the head keeps rocking from side to side and leans a little toward the lens.

5-7 s: the wide-eyed stare again, the mouth wide open in the big grin with the tongue showing, the head rocking side to side.
7-8.5 s: the smug, eyes-shut head shake once more, big and clear.
8.5-10 s: the wide-eyed stare with the mouth wide open, and a last big tilt of the head to one side.
The head moves are big and rhythmic, about one sway each second, never a tiny twitch. The two eyes always close and open together, never one eye at a time, never a wink. Audio: a playful, bouncy beat with no words. No meowing, no barking, no speech.
Exactly one animal: one head, two eyes, one tongue, an animal's own mouth and teeth. No people, no hands, no clothes, no morphing, no cuts, no zoom, no text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
```

```text
A viral "angel or devil filter" video, made from [Image 1]: one continuous selfie shot with no cuts, vertical 9:16, photorealistic, filmed with the phone's front camera at arm's length, chest up, the face large, sharp and in the lower middle of the frame, in the same room or place as [Image 1], so there is space above the head.

The person in the video is the person in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), and keep the clothes, the hair and the place from [Image 1], so their friends recognize them at once. The face stays the same from the first frame to the last.

THE METER, like a phone face filter: at the top of the frame, above the head, two small flat cartoon sticker icons float side by side and stay fixed on the screen the whole time, never on the person: on the LEFT a red cartoon devil face with tiny horns and red bat wings, on the RIGHT a pair of white feathered angel wings with a thin golden halo. Under each icon is ONE big bold white number with a percent sign and a thin dark outline, easy to read. The LEFT number always belongs to the devil and the RIGHT number to the angel.

0-3 s: both numbers start at 0% and count up together. The person looks into the lens with a nervous smile, hands pressed together under the chin, as if praying for a good result.
3-6 s: the numbers climb neck and neck, step by step: 12% and 11%, 25% and 26%, 39% and 38%, 54% and 54%. Small natural head moves: the person glances up at the numbers, bites the lip, raises one eyebrow.
6-8 s: both numbers stop at 58% and 58%: a perfect tie. The person stares at the numbers in mock shock.
8-10 s: the person laughs, shrugs, and gives the camera a sly smirk and a wink: half angel, half devil. No halo and no horns appear.

Audio: a soft quick ticking while the numbers climb, a short drum roll that stops at the tie, and the person's real laugh. No music, no spoken words.
Playful and funny, like a phone face filter: a cartoon halo and cartoon horns, nothing scary. No pentagram, no cross, no religious symbol, no skull, no fangs, no blood, no fire, no black or glowing eyes, no dark horror look. One person only, a grown adult. Five fingers on each hand. The only text in the whole video is the two numbers with their percent signs: no title, no words, no captions, no subtitles, no stickers other than the two icons, no emojis, no logos, no watermark, no app interface.
```

Both dancers = a white hen that stands upright like a person, with its own hen head, red comb and wattles, yellow beak, white feathers, white wings used like arms, and orange hen legs and feet, exactly as in the video. NEVER a human face, human skin or human hands: it stays a hen with feathers. Each one is dressed up as the person in [Image 1]: a wig that copies the hair of [Image 1] exactly (the same hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any braids, curls, locs, bun, headscarf or cap), any glasses, earrings, beard or moustache from [Image 1], and exactly the clothes from [Image 1]: the same top with the same color, pattern and print, and the same trousers, shorts, skirt or dress, sized for the hen. The two dancers look exactly the same, in every frame, so friends laugh and instantly see that the hens are the person in [Image 1]: the same hair, the same clothes, the same glasses.

```text

The barn: weathered vertical wooden boards with thin gaps of daylight, heavy roof beams with a few broken boards and holes in the roof, a hay bale, an old rusty barrel and an old wagon wheel at the sides, dust floating in the beams of light, warm brown tones and deep shadows. The vehicle stands in the middle of the barn in a front three-quarter view, the whole vehicle in frame from the roof to the tires, in the lower half of the picture, with the camera at headlight height and the roof beams and the light above it. Photorealistic, a real photo, not CGI, not a painting. Vertical 9:16. No people and no human faces anywhere in the picture. ```

### Prompt 1

```text
Usa mi foto subida como base. Crea una imagen muy detallada y vívida de una mujer maquillada como una Catrina o una figura asociada al Día de Muertos mexicano, ambientada con una iluminación cálida. La mujer tiene la cara maquillada en el estilo tradicional de calavera de azúcar (calavera). El área de los ojos está rodeada por grandes círculos de color naranja brillante u oro pálido, con un delineado oscuro. Hay detalles florales o de encaje sobre las cejas y en la parte superior de la frente. En el centro de la frente, tiene un adorno que parece una joya roja y dorada, con patrones de pétalos que se extienden hacia las sienes. La nariz está maquillada de negro en forma de un triángulo invertido, imitando la cavidad nasal de un cráneo. Los labios son de un color naranja suave o terracota. Alrededor de la boca, tiene dibujados los dientes de la calavera con líneas finas y curvas negras, que se extienden en una sonrisa elaborada. En las mejillas y la barbilla, hay detalles ornamentales de color dorado, que simulan filigranas o joyas. Los ojos de la mujer son de un color verde o avellana y miran directamente al frente con una expresión seria e intensa. El Tocado y Adornos: Lleva un impresionante tocado o corona en la cabeza. El elemento central del tocado es un cráneo humano (calavera) de color blanco o hueso, ubicado en la parte superior de la cabeza. Alrededor de la calavera y la cabeza, hay una abundancia de rosas de color naranja intenso o cempasúchil, que enmarcan su rostro. Detrás de las flores, hay una estructura dorada que irradia hacia arriba, como una aureola o resplandor con puntas afiladas. Vestimenta y Joyería: Lleva múltiples collares, incluyendo varias vueltas de perlas blancas y varias cadenas de oro grueso con diseños intrincados. Viste una prenda en la parte superior que tiene detalles de encaje blanco o bordado en los hombros. Lleva unos pendientes colgantes grandes y elaborados de color dorado, posiblemente con perlas o gemas colgantes. El fondo está desenfocado (bokeh), pero se aprecian varias velas encendidas que proyectan una luz cálida, dorada y difusa, lo que contribuye a una atmósfera mística y ceremonial, muy acorde con la temática. No cambies mi rostro. Formato vertical 9:16. Una sola persona. Sin texto, sin logotipos, sin marca de agua, sin marcos ni superposiciones.
```

### Prompt 3

```text
Usa mi foto subida como base. Crea una imagen hiperrealista (manteniendo los detalles de la imagen correctamente) con mis rasgos faciales idénticos con características. Esta imagen es un retrato impactante de un hombre cuyo maquillaje está inspirado en las tradiciones del Día de Muertos, específicamente la Calavera Catrina. Descripción Detallada El Maquillaje (Calavera/Cráneo de Azúcar): El rostro del hombre está pintado para parecerse a un cráneo estilizado. Las cuencas de los ojos están dramáticamente agrandadas y pintadas de un vibrante naranja con intrincados detalles en oro, diamantes, perlas y blanco alrededor de los bordes, sugiriendo pétalos de cempasúchil. La nariz está pintada de negro en forma de corazón invertido o nariz de cráneo. El color natural de la piel sirve como base para el resto de su rostro, contrastando con el color oscuro de sus labios. Intrincados diseños de filigrana en oro y blanco adornan su frente, mejillas y barbilla, imitando encaje delicado o joyería.
